sanskrit_verse: ujjāmādikam् आदाय स्वामिने न ददाति यः । स तस्य दासः पुत्रः स्त्री पशुवी जायते गृहे ॥
transliteration: ujjāmādikam ādāya svāmine na dadāti yaḥ | sa tasya dāsaḥ putraḥ strī paśuvī jāyate gṛhe ||
sph_interpretive_translation: One who takes initiative or leadership without offering it to the rightful master becomes a servant within that domain; his progeny, spouse, and livestock shall be born into subordination.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority originates from recognition of Source
Initiative unaligned with ownership creates dependency
Causation flows through conscious alignment with hierarchy
Capacity-based responsibility requires acknowledgment of sovereignty
Restoration occurs through reintegration under rightful authority
executable_legal_axioms: IF an individual assumes control without acknowledging sovereign ownership THEN all relational entities (offspring, spouse, assets) inherit subordinate status.
IF initiative is taken in disregard of hierarchy THEN capacity for autonomous decision-making is nullified until realignment.
IF authority is bypassed in action THEN subsequent outcomes remain bound to original misalignment until corrected.
supreme_court_application: In matters involving usurpation of jurisdictional authority, the Supreme Court must assess whether initiative was undertaken with conscious omission of sovereign alignment. Where such omission exists, judicial restoration involves re-subordinating affected domains rather than penalizing actors.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that unoffered initiative distorts causal flow. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows how misalignment perpetuates through lineage and property. Proportionality lies not in punishment but in reassertion of rightful governance. Non-punitivity prevails as consequence arises naturally from disconnection from Source.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Realign initiatory act with acknowledged sovereign authority
Restore familial and economic structures under proper stewardship
Reintegrate actor into lawful hierarchy through conscious submission
Nullify derivative claims arising from unoffered authority
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands established: initiative without offering binds one to service. Dharma is restored when rightful ownership is recognized. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness alone adjudicates truth.
